verdict.rationale: Mailchimp Transactional keeps a rejection denylist (an allowlist entry automatically removes an address from it) and emits hard-bounce, spam, unsub and reject events, which implies suppressed addresses get rejected. A community report also says Mailchimp removed list members after spam complaints. However, nothing documents automatic suppression on the Marketing side, and one user says Mandrill and Mailchimp still aren't integrated, so suppression being honored across every send type is unsupported. Missing for 10: explicit docs on automatic unsubscribe/bounce/complaint suppression for marketing campaigns, a shared suppression list across Marketing, Transactional and SMS, CAN-SPAM/GDPR-by-default documentation, and hands-on corroboration.
